image_policy: Full frames extracted from the displayed MP4s; no crop, retouch, target-RGB pose fitting, or per-frame alignment.
input_policy: Two adjacent overlapping original panoramas, References 2 and 3. Ours uses broader scene observations and reference views.

PanoSplatt3R.alignment: Native first-input frame and official get_scale using known input baseline. A single fixed similarity transform is used for the whole scene.

NoPoSplat.input: Two 512x512 perspective crops, 90-degree FOV, oriented toward the corridor
NoPoSplat.alignment: Native first-input frame and known input baseline. A single fixed similarity transform is used for the whole scene.
NoPoSplat.coverage: Later bedroom views extend beyond shared input-crop coverage.

camera_convention: OpenGL c2w: +X right, +Y up, camera looks along -Z. Input matrices labeled CV use +X right, +Y down, +Z forward.
